target.statement: URSA-8B-PS-GRPO achieves 75.6% accuracy on GeoQA (full set), the headline result showing the main contribution of PS-GRPO.

compute.basis: Reproducing the headline number requires the full three-stage pipeline: training an 8B MLLM on 1M+ multimodal CoT data, training a PRM on 1.1M process supervision data, and running online RL (PS-GRPO) on 15K examples. Each stage involves large-scale training that is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop within hours.

blockers: Requires training an 8B parameter multimodal model from scratch (Stage I SFT on MMathCoT-1M)
Requires training a process reward model (Stage II) on DualMath-1.1M
Requires online RL (PS-GRPO) on 15K examples (Stage III)
No GPU available on target hardware (8 CPU cores, 16 GB RAM)
Data synthesis relies on Gemini-1.5-Flash-002 API for CoT expansion, rewriting, and misinterpretation insertion
Full training pipeline likely requires multiple high-memory GPUs (e.g., A100/H100) and days of compute
title: Unlocking Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning via Process Reward Model
